description: Two low-frequency oscillators, each sweeping continuously between a triangle and a square wave

params.text: Sweeps the shape of its own oscillator between a triangle at one end and a square at the other
Sets the rate of its own oscillator, eighteen octaves from about 0.0039Hz to 1024Hz

outputs.text: The wave from its own oscillator, in the voltage range chosen on the menu

notes: an oscillator only runs while a cable is patched to its output; unpatched, its phase is held at the start of the cycle.
menu: CV Range: 0V to +5V, 0V to +10V, -5V to +5V, -10V to +10V — sets the voltage range both outputs span; it starts at 0V to +5V, which is what the hardware does
